At 5x the smallest Phase-2 training data, the ~10B backbone scores a normalized offline metric (MRR) of about **1.11**. That is roughly 11% higher than the 1x configuration, which sits at 1.00 (Figure 4, p. 7).

The paper doesn't print this number. The text layer only has the axis ticks, so I read the value off the plot in the PDF. The 5x point lies just under the 1.11 level, between the 1.10 and 1.12 gridlines.

Background:
- **The study:** GenRec was trained on Phase-2 datasets from 1x to 20x the smallest configuration, using two backbones of about 1B and about 10B parameters (p. 6).
- **The trend:** MRR improves steadily as Phase-2 data grows (p. 6). In the figure, the ~10B curve goes from 1.00 at 1x to about 1.05 at 2x, about 1.11 at 5x, about 1.14 at 10x and about 1.16 at 20x (p. 7).
